llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户研究方向无关，研究的是铝合金的增材制造，非生物医学植入物。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure or stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Sc和Zr改性Al-6.2Mg合金的激光选区熔化工艺及性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备合金，表征显微组织和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 优化工艺参数获得致密且性能优异的合金。
summary_zh.validation: 拉伸测试和显微组织观察。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the processability, microstructure, and mechanical properties of a novel Sc and Zr modified Al-6.2 Mg alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated by SLM under various parameters, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Near-full density and improved mechanical properties were achieved with optimized processing parameters.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through tensile testing and microstructural analysis via SEM and EBSD.

summary_zh.method: 通过实验分析不同粉末参数下的孔隙率。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how powder characteristics affect porosity formation in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V components.
summary_en.method: Experimental analysis of powder parameters and resulting porosity.
summary_en.result: Correlations between powder properties and porosity levels were established.

papers.title: Constrained Bayesian Optimization with Noisy Experiments
papers.abstract: Randomized experiments are the gold standard for evaluating the effects of changes to real-world systems. Data in these tests may be difficult to collect and outcomes may have high variance, resulting in potentially large measurement error. Bayesian optimization is a promising technique for efficiently optimizing multiple continuous parameters, but existing approaches degrade in performance when the noise level is high, limiting its applicability to many randomized experiments. We derive an expression for expected improvement under greedy batch optimization with noisy observations and noisy constraints, and develop a quasi-Monte Carlo approximation that allows it to be efficiently optimized. Simulations with synthetic functions show that optimization performance on noisy, constrained problems outperforms existing methods. We further demonstrate the effectiveness of the method with two real-world experiments conducted at Facebook: optimizing a ranking system, and optimizing server compiler flags.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种带噪声约束的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification in physical simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高噪声随机实验中多参数优化效率低的问题。
summary_zh.method: 推导带噪声观测和约束的贪婪批量优化期望改进表达式，并用拟蒙特卡洛近似高效优化。
summary_zh.result: 在带噪声约束问题上优于现有方法，并在Facebook两个真实实验中验证有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成函数仿真和Facebook排名系统、编译器标志优化实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize multiple continuous parameters in randomized experiments with high noise levels, where traditional Bayesian optimization degrades.
summary_en.method: Derived an expression for expected improvement under greedy batch optimization with noisy observations and constraints, and developed a quasi-Monte Carlo approximation for efficient optimization.
summary_en.result: The method outperformed existing approaches on noisy constrained problems and demonstrated effectiveness in two real-world experiments at Facebook.
summary_en.validation: Validated through simulations with synthetic functions and two real-world experiments: optimizing a ranking system and server compiler flags.
